summary:
This source adds a separate current-public-at workload to the existing private NativeQualification repository, with its own dispatch-only main/attempt1 job and exact fsgg-native-at-x11-v1 four-label route. BAR/FourD v1 targets, label defaults and c068 OS/APT recipe remain separate. An AT-capable baked layer/image requires its own actual qualification; the old BAR image is not implicitly AT-capable. Protected AT-layer integration remains behind primary first-BAR acceptance unless actual closed supplier/caller compatibility is independently established. Source preparation creates no VM, registration, dispatch or runtime admission.

ATv2 data binds one closed Noble software body, exact original source run/artifact descriptor,32-root/993-package proposal and bounded resources. The baked driver seals seven fixed factory/import/fixture Git blobs after checking commit/tree/blob body identities, no replacement refs/alternate store or fetch. Empty GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL overrides repository-specific protocol policy, including on Git versions without no-lazy support; actual inert promisor/ext controls retain the prior RED and fixed GREEN. A separate fixed capture reads only RUNNER_TEMP/native-at-pool through no-follow directory handles, stable UID1001 regular single-link files and declared hashes. Failed partial output stays root-private; completed root-owned source/pool seals bind the actual instance and exact membership before privileged factory use. These source controls do not establish provider authority or enforcing whole-VM containment.

The source-only public verifier and private mirror have distinct receipts. The named first-producer candidate keeps exactly eleven leaves: eight additions plus three closed derivations for BAR's source guard, actionlint and README. Canonical producer files bind actual protected source bytes; the fresh old README body/blob and whole public replacement are exact. BAR runtime source validation preserves upstream/main/caller checks while rejecting arbitrary extras and authenticating every added/derived byte. The future helper production revision/ordered payload tuple remains unavailable until real protected source delivery; that missing tuple must refuse readiness. No private caller installation follows public source approval.

The proposed factory prefix first joins actual private run/job/actor/runner and original clock, then exact protected source and complete private caller. Public original producer run/job/artifact metadata is separate from private caller identity. A private job token is repository-limited and cannot be assumed to download another repository's Actions ZIP. The receiver therefore accepts only a fixed root-owned regular single-link source-artifact.zip at /mnt/fsgg-current-at-inputs, joined by its opened descriptor to the exact read-only/nodev/nosuid/noexec mount and original selected length/SHA. It has no arbitrary path/URI override. Actual provider source/attachment, guest mapping and backing/retirement remain unqualified; per-boot REQUEST consumption and bake-only /mnt inputs do not implement this transport. No token/App/policy workaround or substitute producer is selected.

Only after genuine input and source handoffs can a separately selected prefix install frozen Noble software, observe installed role/schema/keymap inputs and retire original display actors. Full current-public browser/Orca/realIME/provider/Studio acceptance is not supplied by this prefix. Templates admission remains None; published package/Rendering producer identity is distinct from controller source. Actual dependency/runtime/browser fit, installed private caller, outer containment, aggregate allocated storage including deleted-open files, reservation and VM retirement remain owed. Existing historical holds/Unknowns and original failed source jobs retain their scope. No automatic retry, replay, old-hold release or publication follows these source changes.
title: Separate private ATv2 source preserves legacy callers and requires real facility handoffs
